prompt:
Create a NEW independent FOREST terrain plate for a layered panoramic landscape. Input image 1 is ONLY a lighting, camera and material reference: a rocky hilltop foreground already approved. Do NOT copy its rocks, flowers, soil or plants into this new forest image. Input image 2 is ONLY a rough scene-layout reference for the height and scale of the forest. Do NOT copy its sky, mountains, foreground meadow, balloon, airship or bird. Generate the new forest on its OWN, with terrain filled completely behind all occluded areas.

Canvas exactly 3840 x 1920 pixels, 2:1 very wide landscape. One coherent continuous full-width landscape view from an elevated rocky overlook toward a forest approximately 400 metres away. The wooded hills descend into a broad shallow valley in the middle. Dense natural Caucasus spruce and fir woodland in calm rich sage and muted olive green. Clean believable conifer silhouettes, broad readable clumps of branches, varied tree heights and spacing, no repeating clones, no noisy needle stippling. At this distance whole tree crowns are visible, not microscopic individual needles. Tallest visible trees around 220-320 pixels high, medium trees 100-180 pixels high. A few warm-lit deciduous crowns among the conifers, restrained not colorful. No nearby isolated giant tree.

Precise U-shaped top outline of this forest plate: left side highest treetops around y=960; x=480 y=1000; x=960 y=1110; x=1440 y=1210; centre x=1920 y=1270; x=2400 y=1210; x=2880 y=1090; x=3360 y=1050; right side y=1060. Heights may vary naturally within 40 pixels, with clean irregular individual treetop silhouettes. Everything ABOVE the tree canopy outline is perfectly flat pure chroma key MAGENTA #FF00FF. No landscape behind the outline: no mountains, no hills, no sky, no clouds, no mist or green halo above trees. The key field must be a single flat color. Keep magenta out of the terrain and out of reflected light.

Everything BELOW that canopy outline is continuous opaque woodland and forested ground all the way to the BOTTOM edge, and extending beyond both SIDE edges. Fill lower hidden regions with coherent forest canopy, so this can move behind a foreground without holes, black strips, transparent gaps or cut-off roots. A naturally receding central valley, NOT a path or road. No separate foreground meadow. The entire bottom row must contain forest terrain. This is a landscape layer, not a floating island, not a sticker floating above an empty lower margin.

Match input 1 camera and style: natural clean high-resolution landscape photograph, 35mm-equivalent wide landscape camera at eye-level on a hill, level horizon, no fisheye, no close-up. Neutral late-morning sunlight from upper left, 5500K, moderate contrast, soft shadows to right. Forest is slightly cooler, lighter and less contrasty than the close foreground because it is farther away, but not foggy. Clear forms with smooth tonal transitions, not crunchy microtexture, not film grain or digital noise. Late summer. No text, labels, borders, people, body parts, silhouettes of people, animals, vehicles, buildings or aircraft. Output only this forest plate and the plain magenta key field above it, no other planes.
